title: AuthorizedDecisionObject
description: ADO v5 — the exclusive authorization artifact issued by a Shani-compliant evaluator. An Execution Agent MUST NOT act without a valid, unexpired ADO whose signature has been verified.

decision_id.description: Matches the DecisionProposal.decision_id this was issued for.

proposal_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical DecisionProposal. Verifiers recompute this from the proposal to detect fake ADOs.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature chain hash over the canonical payload: {decision_id, authority, authorized_dsal, issued_at, expires_at, proposal_hash, nonce, delegation_rules, exec_context, propagated_constraints}. Any field modification invalidates this signature. Agents MUST verify before execution.

authority.description: Human role or policy document that authorized this decision.

authorized_dsal.description: D-SAL level granted. Upper bound on what the agent may do autonomously.

delegation_rules.description: Bounds on child delegation chains. All four fields are included in the signed payload.

nonce.description: Cryptographically random 32-byte token (hex-encoded, 64 chars). Included in signed payload. Consumed on first execution. Replay of this ADO fails because nonce is already registered in NonceStore.

issued_at.description: When this ADO was issued by Shani (UTC).

expires_at.description: When this ADO expires (UTC). Agents MUST check expires_at > now() before execution.

exec_context.description: Execution metadata included in the signed payload.

signature_chain.description: v5.2: Full ADO signature chain (authority_signature → boundary_signature). Serialized ADOSignatureChain.as_dict(). Present when multi-principal signing is configured. SPEC §4.6 SHOULD requirement.

propagated_constraints.description: v5.1: Constraints inherited from the originating principal's UserPosture for cross-org ADOs. MUST be included in the canonical signature payload. Mutation of these fields MUST break signature verification.

origin_org.description: v5.1: Identifier of the originating organization for cross-org ADOs.

DelegationRules.title: DelegationRules
DelegationRules.description: Explicit bounds on what child delegation chains may do. All four fields are included in the signed payload.

allowed_sub_decisions.description: Whitelist of DecisionType values children may propose. Empty = no delegation permitted.

max_child_dsal.description: Maximum D-SAL a child ADO may be authorized at. Enforced invariant: max_child_dsal < parent.authorized_dsal.

max_depth.description: Remaining delegation hops allowed. Decremented by 1 at each delegation. 0 = leaf node, cannot delegate further.

max_children.description: Maximum number of direct child ADOs this ADO may spawn. 0 = no children permitted. Prevents fan-out attacks where one approval spawns thousands of agents.

ExecContext.title: ExecContext
ExecContext.description: Execution context carried by the ADO. Included in the signed payload.

IntentBinding.title: IntentBinding
IntentBinding.description: Cryptographically bound statement of what this ADO authorizes. Included in ExecContext which is part of the signed payload.
